summary: Verified localization bug fix for Profile screen error alerts. Static code inspection confirms /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx lines 72 & 93 now use t('common.error') + t('profile.exportError') / t('profile.deleteError') instead of hardcoded English strings. All three new keys (common.error, profile.exportError, profile.deleteError) exist in en/de/es blocks of /app/frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts with values matching spec exactly. Runtime regression via Playwright (mobile 390x844): signed up throwaway user, accepted disclaimer, opened Profile tab -- profile-name, export-data-row, delete-account-button, language-row all present. Export success path opens JSON modal (export-close visible). Language switch works across EN->DE->ES: DE profile shows 'Konto löschen', 'Abmelden', 'Sprache'; ES profile shows 'Eliminar cuenta', 'Cerrar sesión', 'Idioma'. No design or logic regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix scope is minimal and correct: two Alert.alert literals replaced with t() calls; three keys added to en/de/es dictionaries with exact spec strings.

Since Alert.alert error paths only fire on network failure of /account/export or DELETE /account, live triggering was not forced -- key resolution + code wiring were verified via source inspection and successful language-switch regression on the profile screen (existing translated strings render correctly, confirming I18nContext + t() pipeline is functional).
seed_data_creation: Throwaway user test_1785338861@qapilo.io signed up via UI during regression (7-day Pro trial default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Localization fix for profile error alerts verified end-to-end. No open issues.
rca_of_issue: N/A - straightforward localization bug fix. Two hardcoded English Alert.alert('Error', '...') calls replaced with t()-based keys; keys added to en/de/es dictionaries.
